title: Custom Jersey Builder (2026)
verdict: A custom jersey builder is worth using when it does four things: shows the jersey live, shows the price, takes a roster and lets you check out. In 2026 Wooter's builder does all four across every sport it sells.
Boombah's builders are good and sell direct. Champro's and Nike Team's builders stop at a saved design for a dealer. Custom Ink's Design Lab is a print tool for stock jerseys.
steps_title: Test a jersey builder in five minutes

steps.name: Change a color
steps.text: Does the preview update at once?

steps.name: Look for the price
steps.text: Is it on screen, at your quantity?

steps.name: Find the roster
steps.text: Can you enter each player's name, number and size?

steps.name: Go to checkout
steps.text: Can you pay, or are you sent to a dealer or a quote form?

steps.name: Ask for help
steps.text: Is there a designer if you get stuck?

ranking.fit: Organizers who want one builder for all their teams, with nothing hidden behind a quote.
ranking.lacks: It builds made-to-order jerseys, so delivery is three to four weeks after approval.

ranking.fit: Teams that want a sublimated uniform built online and bought straight from the maker.
ranking.lacks: Sport coverage is narrower, and lead times vary by page.

ranking.fit: Programs that order through a local team dealer and want cut-and-sew sublimation.
ranking.lacks: No price in the builder and no checkout.

ranking.fit: Small groups that want names and numbers printed on a stock jersey in about two weeks.
ranking.lacks: Builds a print layout, not a jersey.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and work with an authorized dealer.

why: Jersey builders look alike on the surface. The differences show up at the end. Some hand you a design code and send you to a dealer. Some ask you to request a quote. A few let you finish the job.
Test any builder with one question: can I see the total and pay it without talking to anyone?
On Wooter the answer is yes. The price sits beside the preview, the roster step takes each player's details, and rosters copy from jerseys to shorts and warmups.

criteria.name: Live preview
criteria.text: The jersey redraws as you edit.

criteria.name: Checkout
criteria.text: You can place the order yourself.

criteria.name: Design fallback
criteria.text: A designer if the builder is not enough.

faq.q: Which jersey builders let me order directly?
faq.a: Wooter and Boombah sell direct. Champro and Nike Team route orders through dealers.
No. Wooter's is free, and so is its design service.

faq.q: Can a builder handle a 200-player league?
faq.a: Yes if it has a real roster step. Wooter's takes each player and copies rosters across products.

faq.q: What if the builder cannot do my idea?
faq.a: Send a design request and a designer takes over.

faq.q: How long from builder to delivery?
faq.a: Three to four weeks after you approve the design at Wooter, with rush production offered.
